interface.shortDescription: Install and manage FDK with Node.js via nvm.
interface.longDescription: Shell Tasks and inline commands for FDK 10 on Node 24, optional FDK 9 on Node 18, uninstall, status, troubleshoot --fix, and workspace nvm/.nvmrc. Legacy /fdk-* slash aliases where registered.

commands.name: fw-setup-install
commands.description: Install FDK 10 + Node 24; optional --version X.Y.Z (CDN pin)

commands.name: fw-setup-upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade FDK; optional --to X.Y.Z semver (CDN vX.Y.Z.tgz)

commands.name: fw-setup-downgrade
commands.description: Downgrade FDK 10 → 9; optional semver 9.x.y or latest 9 line

commands.name: fw-setup-use
commands.description: Workspace stack: nvm use + .nvmrc (10/9); optional --write-nvmrc; inline only

interface.shortDescription: Platform 3.0 apps: React Meta (default), manifest, requests, OAuth, serverless.
interface.longDescription: Enforces Platform 3.0 patterns with slash commands /fdk-react-create, /fdk-react-migrate, /fdk-fix, /fdk-migrate, /fdk-refactor. For structured pre-submission review, use the fw-review skill. Does not install FDK or Node — use the fw-setup skill for the toolchain.

commands.name: fdk-react-create
commands.description: Create a new React Meta app (default UI stack)

commands.name: fdk-react-migrate
commands.description: Migrate vanilla JS Platform 3.0 app to React Meta

commands.name: fdk-fix
commands.description: Fix all platform validation errors and lint errors

commands.name: fdk-migrate
commands.description: Migrate Platform 2.3 (2.x), FDK 9.x, Node 18 → Platform 3.0, FDK 10, Node 24

commands.name: fdk-refactor
commands.description: Reduce function complexity to meet cyclomatic complexity ≤ 7

interface.shortDescription: actions.json, SMI handlers, request templates, and third-party API integrations.
interface.longDescription: Expert guidance for flat request parameters, nested responses in server.js, iparams/OAuth, fdk validate, test data, and integration scoping. Pair with fw-app-dev for full marketplace UI apps and fw-setup for the toolchain.

interface.shortDescription: Structured app review: rules, deterministic scripts, report format.
interface.longDescription: Silent pipeline over manifest, iparams, frontend rules, and script-backed checks. Pair with fw-setup for FDK availability and fw-app-dev for fixes after review.
Auth preflight, fdk validate/pack, app-upload, submit/update via MCP. API key from https://developers.freshworks.com/developer/. Pair with fw-app-dev for manifest and validation fixes.
